current: No ledger-commit signal and no ledger-lag threshold exist. The nearest real mechanism is the cell's cached capital envelope. A cell's fills reach the centre's books only through its reports (CentralPlane::ingest -> settle/record_realised, plane.rs:2079). When the centre is unreachable, the cell keeps acting only within the signed VerifiedEnvelope it already holds, because the centre renews envelopes over the capital downlink and cannot while it is unreachable. Once that envelope expires, every new money-risking intent is refused under 'envelope_expiry' (cell.rs:3490-3500). The envelope's TTL is therefore the only bound on how long a cell acts unaccounted, and it is a fixed time, not a lag measurement.
